raw_segments.text: I am Charles Edward, King of England.
My father has resigned all his legal rights to me.
I have fought in defense of them, and above 800 of my adherents have been hanged, drawn,
I have been confined in prison.
I am going to Rome to pay a visit to the King, my father, who was dethroned as well as myself
and my grandfather, and I am come to spend the carnival at Venice.
